item.title: The Other Kind Of “If It Doesn’t Scan, It Must Be Free!”
item.description: Read The Other Kind Of “If It Doesn’t Scan, It Must Be Free!” Me: "Uh… ma'am, this isn't going to work." Customer: "It's a credit card." Me: "It's not laminated or embossed. In fact, if I were to guess, I'd say this was printed out on a home color printer." Read The Other Kind Of “If It Doesn’t Scan, It Must Be Free!”

item.title: A Returned Grill Gets You A Grilling
item.description: Read A Returned Grill Gets You A Grilling Customer: "I want a refund." My Mom: "Sir, this is a craft store." Customer: "And I want a refund!" My Mom: "We don't sell BBQs… because it's a craft store. You must have got mixed up about what store you're at." Read A Returned Grill Gets You A Grilling

item.title: When Your Customer Base Are The Fat Cats
item.description: Read When Your Customer Base Are The Fat Cats Customer: "I need to return this cat tree." Me: "What's the reason for the return?" Customer: "My cat's a fat-a**." Read When Your Customer Base Are The Fat Cats

item.title: Hospitality Meets Hostility
item.description: Read Hospitality Meets Hostility The same people tried to come in the next week and sat in my section. I refused to serve them and explained the situation to a different head manager. He personally cooked their food, did most of the serving, and they still tried to get their meal for free. He banned them. Read Hospitality Meets Hostility
